name: 06069 · Sharon, CT
findings: ZIP 06069 (Sharon) has 16 nonprofit organizations. 8 of them (50%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 7 organizations.
Arts and cultural organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (33% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 06069 (Sharon) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
25% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 06069 (Sharon) list volunteering in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 3.4 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 6 organizations here; 31% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are ways to volunteer so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
